changes: External cancellation signals only record a bounded request, never raise through arbitrary Python cleanup frames.
Existing budget.check first enforces the unchanged deadline, then raises pending cancellation before additional ordinary SQL/work. Cleanup checks honor deadlines and allow orderly failure cleanup.
SIGALRM continues to interrupt immediately; pure operations still obey original stage/global timers, no new grace or extra SQL.
Retain failure result/markers/strict replay guard and original all110 tests. Add actual runtime cancellation-before-SQL regression.
justification: An asynchronously raising cancellation handler can interrupt finally before its cleanup guard is set. Recording cancellation and raising at existing budget safepoints closes that entry race without blocking deadline alarms.
